richiami.difetto: The Safety Recall relates to the interior rear-view mirror.  The interior  mirror mounting plate may not have been bonded to the windscreen  sufficiently. Due to an insufficient adhesive surface on the mounting plate  (bracket) the rearview mirror could become partially or even completely  detached from the windshield. If the rearview mirror becomes partially or  even completely detached this could impair the visibility while driving. In  the event of an accident this could increase the risk of injury.
richiami.rimedio: On the affected vehicles the windscreen (with mounting plate) will be checked and if necessary replaced

richiami.difetto: The casing of the high-voltage (HV) battery may not be watertight, risking water entry. If water enters, a message alerts the driver about an insulation fault. Ignoring this warning can cause the HV battery to shut down mid-drive, leading the vehicle to decelerate to a stop, creating a risk of accidents and injuries. Additionally, there's a risk of fire, even when the vehicle is parked. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

traduzione.difetto: Il contenitore della batteria ad alta tensione (HV) potrebbe non essere impermeabile all'acqua, mettendo a rischio l'ingresso di acqua. Se l'acqua penetra, un messaggio avvisa il conducente di un difetto di isolamento. Ignorare questo avviso può causare la chiusura della batteria HV durante la guida, provocando la decelerazione e l'arresto del veicolo, con rischio di incidenti e lesioni. Inoltre, esiste il rischio di incendio, anche quando il veicolo è parcheggiato. Il prodotto non rispetta il Regolamento sulla omologazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

richiami.difetto: In certain conditions moisture could gain entry into the wiring connector that powers the Electronic Power Steering (EPS) and the EPS unit. This moisture can then in very rare cases penetrate the EPS through the ground pin and cause overheating of the ground connector pin  which can in turn lead to fire.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the supplementary wiring harness with one that has an improved connector sealing arrangement.
